positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Led development of company-wide AI initiatives, including an advanced RAG-powered chatbot to unify access and retrieval of internal employee documents. Architected cloud infrastructure and data pipelines to migrate 20TB+ of data from on-premises servers to the cloud. Designed and launched an internal site to replace a third-party provider, reducing annual infrastructure spend by $100K+.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Key early hire who built the company’s full cloud infrastructure, data systems, and backend business logic, contributing to $1M+ in ARR within 12 months. Designed and implemented cloud-based data pipelines and ETL processes to power data acquisition, while collaborating closely with leadership and clients to deliver seamless feature rollouts and updates.

positions.title: Data Analyst Supervisor
positions.description: Spearheaded a team of data analysts to optimize company-wide reporting and enhance business decision-making, while creating a custom SQL training program that boosted onboarding efficiency and team productivity. Partnered with executive leadership to deliver impactful quarterly and annual earnings presentations, strengthening transparency and driving $100M+ in additional investments through effective investor outreach. Applied advanced data mining techniques to uncover new market segments, refine targeting strategies, and accelerate business growth and diversification.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Devised and deployed advanced machine learning models that boosted marginal revenues by $10M+, while pioneering new reporting methods to optimize algorithmically-driven customer acquisition strategies. Leveraged Microsoft SQL Server to build backend tables and procedures, delivering robust analytics support for new business initiatives and enabling data-driven decision-making and expansion.

positions.title: Student Teaching Assistant

·	Assisted students with learning class material
·	Held review and exam preparation sections

positions.description:
